exact_m1: decision_time must exactly match an M1 bar-open timestamp
independent_one_position: Sort each benchmark by decision_time. Admit when decision_time is at or after the prior admitted decision_time plus that benchmark's fixed planned horizon.
global_same_decision: Collapse all benchmarks at one decision_time into one simultaneous group.
global_one_position: When free, admit the simultaneous group and block until decision_time plus the longest planned horizon among benchmarks in that group. This is a conservative deterministic count, not a performance selection.
year_attribution: Count an admitted event in the year of its decision_time.
